svg.title: Human research first. Machine learning built on top.
svg.desc: Four-station loop around a reservoir of the client's research history: human research fields studies; results calibrate a synthetic panel; the panel screens and sharpens concepts, packaging, copy, claims, ads, flavors and names in synthetic surveys and focus groups with 50 to 500 synthetic customers; real respondents field the finalists; their answers recalibrate the panel.
svg.text: Concepts, packaging, copy, claims, ads, flavors and
names are tested with 50–500 calibrated synthetic
customers to screen out the weak options cheaply.
Real respondents decide the winner from sharpened
finalists, with results recalibrating the synthetic panel.
Pervasive InsightsTM · A City Research Solutions product
